Frost Death Knight Rotation in 

Frost's rotation is about spending procs and managing resources. It does not follow a strict builder/spender pattern, as both of its resources are used to generate each other.

 

 

 
 Spend Killing Machine: Killing Machine is the foundation for all our damage. In addition to a guaranteed crit, it also triggers effects like Arctic Assault , Bonegrinder , and Killing Streak .
 

 

 
 

 
 Spend Rime: Cast Howling Blast with Rime as much as possible. Rime triggers Frostbound Will to recover Empower Rune Weapon faster, granting more Killing Machine procs. 
 

 

 
 

 
 Use Pillar of Frost off cooldown: Pillar of Frost has a relatively short cooldown and should not be held to avoid losing casts.

Pre-Combat Check

 Before any combat happens, it is important for Frost Death Knight to make sure the following are done. This applies to raids, dungeons, delves, or even open-world content.

 Frost Death Knight Major Cooldowns

Frost only has a few major cooldowns. They should be used alongside each other as much as possible. You never want to use one on its own. Frost's cooldowns require little setup and planning, but there are a few interactions between them to consider.

 
Pillar of Frost

 Pillar of Frost is extremely simple by itself, but it serves as an activator for some important effects. 

 The most important is Obliteration , which alters the feel of the rotation while Pillar of Frost is active. The overall priority does not change, but you will notice that during Pillar of Frost you are pressing Obliterate more often to keep spending Killing Machine . Frozen Dominion does not impact your rotation, but it is important to be aware that it makes Remorseless Winter an automatic passive, so we still take talents that buff it in AoE builds.

 
Frostwyrm's Fury

 Frostwyrm's Fury is integral to Frost in Midnight, thanks for the Apex talents. The most important thing to know is to never cast Frostwyrm's Fury without Pillar of Frost , otherwise you will waste Chosen of Frostbrood . Other concerns are specific to each Hero Talent.

 can use Frostwyrm's Fury immediately after pressing Pillar of Frost. The recall cast can be saved for the best opportunity you can find during Pillar of Frost. This will be when either you get the best buff overlap, or when you can hit the most targets.

 wants to use Frostwyrm's Fury as soon as possible after Pillar of Frost. Frostwyrm's Fury summons all the Horsemen through Apocalypse Now , meaning Apocalyptic Conquest is active. We want to overlap it with Pillar of Frost's strength buff to keep our Strength as high as possible as long as possible.

 
Reaper's Mark

 Reaper's Mark is used on cooldown, on the same GCD as Pillar of Frost if it is available. Pairing with Pillar of Frost is especially important in AoE to overlap the Strength buff with the hits from Wave of Souls . Ensure your target does not already have Reaper's Mark when carrying an Exterminate into a new pack. Applying Reaper's Mark to a target that already has it will prematurely end the existing mark.

 Frost Death Knight Advanced Tips

 
Understanding Killing Streak

 Killing Streak poses an important question: should I intentionally wait for two stacks of Killing Machine ? The short answer is no. Killing Machine stacks to two to give us some rotational breathing room, but do not try to intentionally go to two stacks.

Frost wants to spend as many GCDs as possible on spending Killing Machine, and as few GCDs as possible on casting Obliterate / Frostscythe without Killing Machine. Obliterate deals over double its normal damage with Killing Machine, and Frostscythe deals four times its normal damage. You deal more damage overall by spending two single Killing Machine abilities than by consuming double Killing Machine. The bonus crit damage from Killing Streak is not nearly as much as the difference between an unbuffed hit and a hit buffed by Killing Machine.
